blocks.zh: SSCC 特殊要求 SSCC Special Requirement
blocks.en: SSCC Special Requirement

blocks.zh: Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) 使用 GS1-128 編碼，X-dimension 最小值提高至 0.50 mm（而非一般 0.25 mm）。這是因為棧板條碼需在更遠距離或更惡劣環境中掃描。
blocks.en: The Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) is encoded in GS1-128, and its minimum X-dimension is raised to 0.50 mm (instead of the general 0.25 mm). This is because pallet barcodes must be scanned from a greater distance or in harsher environments.

blocks.zh: X 尺寸 vs 掃描距離對照
blocks.en: X-dimension vs scanning distance

blocks.zh: X-dimension（窄元素寬度）直接影響掃描距離與資料容量：
blocks.en: The X-dimension (narrow element width) directly affects scanning distance and data capacity:

blocks.zh: 安靜區 10× 規則 Quiet Zone 10× Rule
blocks.en: Quiet Zone 10× Rule

blocks.zh: 當 X-dimension >0.64 mm 時，安靜區（quiet zone）從固定的 6.4 mm 改為動態計算：
blocks.en: When the X-dimension is >0.64 mm, the quiet zone changes from a fixed 6.4 mm to a dynamic calculation:

blocks.zh: 安靜區 ≥ 10 × X-dimension
blocks.en: Quiet zone ≥ 10 × X-dimension

blocks.zh: 例：X-dim = 0.81 mm → 安靜區 ≥ 8.1 mm（每側）。此規則確保高速掃描器有足夠的「呼吸空間」判斷符號邊界。
blocks.en: Example: X-dim = 0.81 mm → quiet zone ≥ 8.1 mm (each side). This rule gives high-speed scanners enough "breathing room" to find the symbol boundary.

blocks.zh: 符號學識別碼比喻 Symbology Identifier Analogy
blocks.en: Symbology Identifier Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像條碼掃描器同時能讀英文、法文、西班牙文。讀到資料後，如何知道是哪種語言？答案是前綴碼（]C1 = 英文/GS1；]A0 = 法文/Code 39；]C0 = 西班牙文/Code 128）。系統收到前綴才能正確解析後面的 AI 或 DI 資料結構。
blocks.en: Imagine a barcode scanner that can read English, French and Spanish. Once it has read the data, how does it know which language it is? The answer is the prefix code (]C1 = English/GS1; ]A0 = French/Code 39; ]C0 = Spanish/Code 128). Only when the system receives the prefix can it correctly parse the AI or DI data structure that follows.

blocks.zh: 列印品質等級 1.5/10/660 解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting print quality grade 1.5/10/660

blocks.zh: 1.5 — 最低整體等級（C 等；滿分 4.0/A 等），這是最基本門檻
blocks.en: 1.5 — the minimum overall grade (grade C; the maximum is 4.0/A); this is the basic threshold

blocks.zh: 10 — 量測孔徑 0.250 mm（參考號 10），對應 8 mil 條碼
blocks.en: 10 — measurement aperture 0.250 mm (reference number 10), corresponding to an 8 mil barcode

blocks.zh: 660 — 光源波長 660 nm（紅光），對應大多數雷射掃描器
blocks.en: 660 — light source wavelength 660 nm (red light), matching most laser scanners

blocks.zh: 無人值守自動掃描建議使用更高等級（如 2.0/10/660 或以上）
blocks.en: For unattended automatic scanning, a higher grade is recommended (such as 2.0/10/660 or above)

blocks.en: Annex B — Guidelines for Using 2D Symbols

blocks.zh: DataMatrix DPM 應用與 GS1 Digital Link 趨勢
blocks.en: DataMatrix DPM applications and the GS1 Digital Link trend

blocks.zh: DataMatrix ECC200 在製藥 DPM 的應用
blocks.en: DataMatrix ECC200 in pharmaceutical DPM

blocks.zh: DPM（Direct Part Marking） — 直接標記在零件/容器本身，不依賴紙質標籤：
blocks.en: DPM (Direct Part Marking) — marking directly on the part/container itself, without relying on a paper label:

blocks.zh: 適用：玻璃安瓿、金屬閥門組件、醫療器材金屬外殼
blocks.en: Suitable for: glass ampoules, metal valve components, metal housings of medical devices

blocks.zh: 最小模組尺寸：0.381 mm（ISO 15394 附錄）
blocks.en: Minimum module size: 0.381 mm (ISO 15394 annex)

blocks.zh: 損傷恢復能力：ECC200 可承受 25% 面積損傷後仍可讀取（最高等級 ECC）
blocks.en: Damage recovery: ECC200 can still be read after 25% area damage (highest ECC level)

blocks.zh: 掃描器需求：通常需要 2D 影像掃描器，不能用雷射掃描器
blocks.en: Scanner requirement: generally a 2D imaging scanner is required; a laser scanner cannot be used

blocks.zh: 製藥 GS1 應用：AI (01) GTIN + AI (10) Lot + AI (17) Expiry 整合於單一 DataMatrix
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical GS1 application: AI (01) GTIN + AI (10) Lot + AI (17) Expiry combined in a single DataMatrix

blocks.zh: GS1 Digital Link QR Code — 趨勢解析
blocks.en: GS1 Digital Link QR Code — trend analysis

blocks.zh: GS1 Digital Link 是下一代條碼架構，允許 QR Code 同時服務：
blocks.en: GS1 Digital Link is the next-generation barcode architecture, allowing one QR Code to serve both:

blocks.zh: B2B：掃描 → 傳統 GS1 資料（GTIN, 批號, 有效期）
blocks.en: B2B: scan → traditional GS1 data (GTIN, lot number, expiry date)

blocks.zh: B2C：掃描 → 網頁 URL（產品資訊、召回通知、防偽查核）
blocks.en: B2C: scan → web page URL (product information, recall notices, anti-counterfeiting checks)
Example format: https://id.gs1.org/01/09521234543213/10/ABC123/17/261231

blocks.zh: 製藥意義：一個 QR Code 可同時滿足 ISO 15394 追蹤需求與患者資訊需求，預計 2027 年後 GS1 Digital Link 將逐步取代 GS1-128。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical significance: one QR Code can meet both the ISO 15394 tracking needs and patient information needs; GS1 Digital Link is expected to gradually replace GS1-128 after 2027.

blocks.zh: PDF417 容量估算邏輯
blocks.en: Logic for estimating PDF417 capacity

blocks.zh: PDF417 容量受四個變數共同決定：
blocks.en: PDF417 capacity is determined jointly by four variables:

blocks.zh: X-dimension ↑ → 符號寬度 ↑，容量 ↓
blocks.en: X-dimension ↑ → symbol width ↑, capacity ↓

blocks.zh: 資料欄位數 ↑ → 寬度 ↑，容量 ↑（最多 18 欄，建議 ≤12）
blocks.en: Number of data columns ↑ → width ↑, capacity ↑ (up to 18 columns, recommended ≤12)

blocks.zh: 符號高度 ↑ → 容量 ↑（最大 61 mm）
blocks.en: Symbol height ↑ → capacity ↑ (maximum 61 mm)

blocks.zh: 錯誤更正等級 ↑ → 容量 ↓（冗餘資料增加）
blocks.en: Error correction level ↑ → capacity ↓ (more redundant data)

blocks.zh: 實際範例（X=0.25 mm, 12 欄, 高度 50 mm）：約 601 個字元（含錯誤更正 Level 5）
blocks.en: Practical example (X = 0.25 mm, 12 columns, height 50 mm): approximately 601 characters (including error correction Level 5)

blocks.zh: 掃描器視野限制：若設備最大視野 76 mm，符號寬度不得超過此值，需改用「高而窄」的符號配置。
blocks.en: Scanner field-of-view limit: if the equipment's maximum field of view is 76 mm, the symbol width must not exceed this value, and a "tall and narrow" symbol layout must be used instead.

blocks.zh: MaxiCode 比喻 — 快遞公司的秘密武器
blocks.en: MaxiCode analogy — the courier company's secret weapon

blocks.zh: MaxiCode 是 UPS 為高速輸送帶開發的符號，固定大小（約 2.8 cm × 2.7 cm）、六角形蜂巢結構，掃描器可從任何角度讀取。就像高速公路收費站的 ETC 感應器 — 不需對準、高速通過仍可讀取。Mode 2/3 優先解碼郵遞區號，即使符號受損也能完成分揀。
blocks.en: MaxiCode is a symbol developed by UPS for high-speed conveyors. It has a fixed size (about 2.8 cm × 2.7 cm) and a hexagonal honeycomb structure, and scanners can read it from any angle. It is like the ETC sensor at a highway toll station: no need to aim, and it can still be read at high speed. Modes 2/3 decode the postal code first, so sorting can be completed even if the symbol is damaged.

blocks.zh: Macro PDF417 — 大型資料的串接機制
blocks.en: Macro PDF417 — concatenation for large data

blocks.zh: 當單一 PDF417 符號無法容納全部資料時，使用 Macro PDF417：
blocks.en: When a single PDF417 symbol cannot hold all the data, use Macro PDF417:

blocks.zh: 適用：支援文件應用（B.3），資料 >1,200 字元時建議規劃串接
blocks.en: Suitable for: supporting document applications (B.3); when data exceeds >1,200 characters, plan for concatenation

blocks.zh: 出貨/接收應用（B.2）禁止使用 Macro PDF417
blocks.en: Shipping/receiving applications (B.2) prohibit Macro PDF417

blocks.zh: 解碼器必須支援符號識別碼 ]L1（表示含轉義字元與序列字元）
blocks.en: The decoder must support symbology identifier ]L1 (indicating escape characters and sequence characters are included)

blocks.zh: 掃描時若被其他符號中斷，將中斷串接序列，結果不可預測
blocks.en: If scanning is interrupted by another symbol, the concatenation sequence is broken and the result is unpredictable

blocks.en: Practice Exercise 1 — PDF417 Layout Design

blocks.zh: 你的外箱標籤寬度為 102 mm，需編碼 350 個字元（含 GS1 AIs）。選擇：
blocks.en: Your shipping carton label is 102 mm wide and needs to encode 350 characters (including GS1 AIs). Choose:

blocks.en: Should the X-dimension be 0.25 mm or 0.43 mm? (Hint: see Table B.1 and B.3)

blocks.zh: Clause 6 — Data Carriers｜資料載體
blocks.en: Clause 6 — Data Carriers

blocks.zh: 標籤四大必要區域 Four Mandatory Label Zones
blocks.en: Four Mandatory Label Zones

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 標籤佈局由四個功能性區域構成，每個區域承載特定資料與特定條碼：
blocks.en: The ISO 15394 label layout consists of four functional zones, each carrying specific data and specific barcodes:

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 標籤佈局示意圖
blocks.en: ISO 15394 label layout diagram

blocks.zh:
Ship To / Routing Zone｜出貨目的地區
收件方地址、郵遞區號、國家 — 必須機讀（GS1-128 SSCC）
blocks.en:
Ship To / Routing Zone
Recipient address, postal code, country — must be machine-readable (GS1-128 SSCC)

blocks.zh:
Carrier Zone｜載具區
MaxiCode 符號位置（UPS/FedEx 等）；運送路線碼
blocks.en:
Carrier Zone
Position of the MaxiCode symbol (UPS/FedEx, etc.); shipping route code

blocks.zh:
Customer / Product Zone｜客戶/產品區
GTIN、批號、有效期、數量 — GS1-128 主要條碼；可含 QR Code
blocks.en:
Customer / Product Zone
GTIN, lot number, expiry date, quantity — main GS1-128 barcode; may include a QR Code

blocks.zh:
Human Readable Information (HRI) Zone｜人眼可讀區
AI 資料的明文呈現；置於對應條碼正下方或上方
blocks.en:
Human Readable Information (HRI) Zone
Plain-text presentation of the AI data; placed directly below or above the corresponding barcode

blocks.zh: GS1-128 作為主要載體的理由
blocks.en: Why GS1-128 is the primary carrier

blocks.zh: 通用性：全球所有 GS1 成員組織與貿易夥伴均認可 GS1-128
blocks.en: Universality: GS1-128 is recognized by all GS1 member organizations and trading partners worldwide

blocks.zh: AI 結構：應用識別碼（AI）前綴確保每筆資料的語義明確（如 AI 01 = GTIN；AI 17 = 有效期）
blocks.en: AI structure: the Application Identifier (AI) prefix gives each data element clear semantics (for example, AI 01 = GTIN; AI 17 = expiry date)

blocks.zh: FNC1 標記：GS1-128 特有的 FNC1 字元標示 AI 邊界，避免資料混淆
blocks.en: FNC1 marker: the FNC1 character unique to GS1-128 marks AI boundaries and avoids confusion between data elements

blocks.zh: 成熟基礎設施：ERP、WMS、TMS 系統均內建 GS1-128 解碼支援
blocks.en: Mature infrastructure: ERP, WMS and TMS systems all have built-in GS1-128 decoding support

blocks.zh: 主條碼 vs 補充符號比喻
blocks.en: Primary barcode vs supplementary symbol analogy

blocks.zh: GS1-128 就像護照（全球通用、有固定格式與欄位）；DataMatrix/QR Code 則像護照內夾帶的簽證貼紙（補充特定國家的額外資訊）。海關看護照，特定通道看簽證。同樣地，WMS 掃 GS1-128，藥局追溯系統掃 DataMatrix。
blocks.en: GS1-128 is like a passport (universally accepted, with a fixed format and fields); DataMatrix/QR Code is like the visa sticker inside the passport (supplementary information for a specific country). Customs checks the passport, and a specific lane checks the visa. Likewise, the WMS scans GS1-128, and the pharmacy traceability system scans DataMatrix.

blocks.zh: 多符號共存的干擾風險
blocks.en: Interference risk when multiple symbols coexist

blocks.zh: 當一張標籤上有多個條碼時，需注意：
blocks.en: When a label carries several barcodes, note the following:

blocks.zh: 線性條碼不得超過 2 個並排，且不可在同一水平掃描路徑上
blocks.en: No more than 2 linear barcodes side by side, and not on the same horizontal scan path

blocks.zh: 2D 符號需位於標籤的指定區域（客戶區或載具區）
blocks.en: 2D symbols must be located in the designated area of the label (customer zone or carrier zone)

blocks.zh: 所有符號須保持各自的安靜區，不得相互侵入
blocks.en: All symbols must keep their own quiet zones, which must not intrude on one another

blocks.zh: Macro PDF417 串接讀取期間，掃描到其他符號將中斷整個串接序列
blocks.en: While a Macro PDF417 concatenation is being read, scanning another symbol will interrupt the entire concatenation sequence

blocks.zh: Clause 7 — Label Design｜標籤設計規範
blocks.en: Clause 7 — Label Design

blocks.zh: 標籤設計實務 Label Design Practice
blocks.en: Label Design Practice

blocks.zh: HRI 格式規範 — AI 括號規則
blocks.en: HRI format rules — AI parentheses

blocks.zh: HRI（人眼可讀資訊）的 AI 顯示規則：
blocks.en: Display rules for AIs in the HRI (human-readable information):

blocks.zh: 條碼編碼：無括號，AI 直接嵌入；可變長度 AI 後接 FNC1 分隔符
blocks.en: Barcode encoding: no parentheses; the AIs are embedded directly; a variable-length AI is followed by an FNC1 separator

blocks.zh: FNC1 在 GS1-128 中不可見，但告知解碼器此 AI 已結束
blocks.en: FNC1 is not visible in GS1-128, but it tells the decoder that this AI has ended

blocks.zh: 括號只是 HRI 的顯示慣例，不是資料的一部份
blocks.en: The parentheses are only a display convention of the HRI and are not part of the data

blocks.zh: 顏色與對比度的關鍵陷阱
blocks.en: Key pitfalls with colour and contrast

blocks.zh: 常見設計錯誤與後果：
blocks.en: Common design errors and their consequences:

blocks.zh: 紅色墨水：660 nm 紅光掃描器「看不見」紅色條碼，因紅光被紅墨水反射（顏色相同）→ 條碼完全不可讀
blocks.en: Red ink: a 660 nm red-light scanner "cannot see" a red barcode, because the red light is reflected by the red ink (same colour) → the barcode is completely unreadable

blocks.zh: 深色底色：黑條碼印在深藍底 → PCS 不足 → 品質不合格
blocks.en: Dark background: a black barcode printed on a dark blue background → insufficient PCS → fails the quality grade

blocks.zh: 牛皮紙（Kraft）：棕色底對條碼對比不友好，建議貼白色標籤底材
blocks.en: Kraft paper: a brown background gives poor contrast for barcodes; a white label substrate is recommended

blocks.zh: 光澤面材：鏡面反射可能造成掃描器過曝，降低解碼成功率
blocks.en: Glossy materials: specular reflection may overexpose the scanner and reduce the decoding success rate

blocks.zh: Bearer Bars 比喻
blocks.en: Bearer Bars analogy

blocks.zh: Bearer bars 就像條碼的「護欄」。想像在高速公路橋上的車道護欄 — 主要功能是防止車輛偏離，同時強化橋身結構。Bearer bars 讓掃描器的雷射光束在穿越整個條碼時維持在正確的水平路徑上，不會提前「掉落」邊緣，在波浪型瓦楞紙箱上特別重要。
blocks.en: Bearer bars are the "guardrails" of a barcode. Think of the lane guardrails on a highway bridge: their main function is to keep vehicles from veering off, while also strengthening the bridge structure. Bearer bars keep the scanner's laser beam on the correct horizontal path as it crosses the whole barcode, so it does not "fall off" the edge early. This is especially important on wavy corrugated cartons.

blocks.zh: 標籤面積規劃公式
blocks.en: Label area planning formula

blocks.zh: 設計標籤時，所需最小寬度估算：
blocks.en: When designing a label, estimate the minimum required width as follows:

blocks.zh: GS1-128 寬度 = (資料字元數 × 11 + 35) × X-dimension + 2 × 安靜區
blocks.en: GS1-128 width = (number of data characters × 11 + 35) × X-dimension + 2 × quiet zone

blocks.zh: 安靜區 = max(6.4 mm, 10 × X-dimension)（當 X >0.64 mm）
blocks.en: Quiet zone = max(6.4 mm, 10 × X-dimension) (when X >0.64 mm)

blocks.zh: 實務標籤寬度：通常取 102 mm 或 152 mm 標準尺寸以確保足夠空間
blocks.en: Practical label width: usually take a standard size of 102 mm or 152 mm to ensure enough space

blocks.zh: 高度分配（由上至下）：Ship To 文字區 → 條碼區（≥12.7 mm）→ HRI 文字區 → 間距 → 下一段
blocks.en: Height allocation (top to bottom): Ship To text zone → barcode zone (≥12.7 mm) → HRI text zone → spacing → next segment

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2 — 顏色合規驗證
blocks.en: Practice Exercise 2 — Colour Compliance Check

blocks.zh: 客戶要求在以下情況列印條碼，哪些情況可能不合規？
blocks.en: A customer asks for barcodes to be printed in the following cases. Which cases may be non-compliant?

blocks.zh: 黑色條碼印在黃色底材上（660 nm 測試）
blocks.en: Black barcode printed on a yellow substrate (660 nm test)

blocks.zh: 深藍色條碼印在白色底材上
blocks.en: Dark blue barcode printed on a white substrate

blocks.zh: 紅色條碼印在白色底材上（660 nm 光源）
blocks.en: Red barcode printed on a white substrate (660 nm light source)

blocks.zh: 高度要求：400–800 mm（叉車掃描最佳高度範圍）；不得跨越轉角；緊鄰但不超越棧板邊角位置。
blocks.en: Height requirement: 400–800 mm (the best height range for forklift scanning); must not wrap around a corner; placed close to, but not beyond, the pallet corner position.

blocks.zh: 4 面能見度 vs 倉庫操作比喻
blocks.en: 4-side visibility vs warehouse operations analogy

blocks.zh: 想像叉車司機在倉庫中以任意角度靠近棧板。如果標籤只貼一面，司機從背面開過來時看不到條碼，需要繞行一圈 — 在繁忙倉庫中既浪費時間又危險。4 面貼標就像路口四向路標，無論從哪個方向進入都能找到資訊。
blocks.en: Imagine a forklift driver approaching a pallet from any angle in the warehouse. If the label is on only one side, a driver coming from the back cannot see the barcode and has to drive around the pallet, which wastes time and is dangerous in a busy warehouse. Labelling all 4 sides is like the road signs at a four-way intersection: whichever direction you enter from, you can find the information.

blocks.zh: 標籤貼附位置合規性稽核重點
blocks.en: Key audit points for label placement compliance

blocks.zh: 在稽核供應商的標籤作業時，重點確認：
blocks.en: When auditing a supplier's labelling operation, focus on confirming:

blocks.zh: 高度合規：棧板標籤底部距地 400 mm，頂部不超過 800 mm
blocks.en: Height compliance: the bottom of the pallet label is 400 mm above the floor and the top does not exceed 800 mm

blocks.zh: 無跨角：標籤面積 100% 在單一面板上，不跨邊角
blocks.en: No wrap-around: 100% of the label area is on a single panel and does not wrap around an edge or corner

blocks.zh: 無覆蓋：標籤不得被收縮膜接縫、捆紮帶或其他標籤覆蓋
blocks.en: No obstruction: the label must not be covered by shrink-wrap seams, strapping or other labels

blocks.zh: 黏貼牢固：四個角不翹起，整面貼合，無氣泡
blocks.en: Firm adhesion: the four corners do not lift, the whole label is in contact with the surface, and there are no air bubbles

blocks.zh: 可掃性驗證：實際以掃描器在正常操作距離測試，非目視判斷
blocks.en: Scannability verification: test with an actual scanner at normal operating distance, not by visual judgement

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3 — 棧板標籤合規評估
blocks.en: Practice Exercise 3 — Pallet Label Compliance Assessment

blocks.zh: 一批冷藏藥品出貨，棧板高度 1.2 m，外裹透明收縮膜後再用黑色束帶綑綁（束帶間距 30 cm）。請評估：
blocks.en: A batch of refrigerated pharmaceuticals is shipped on a pallet 1.2 m high, wrapped in clear shrink film and then bound with black straps (30 cm apart). Please assess:

blocks.zh: 標籤應貼在收縮膜外還是膜內？（各有何風險？）
blocks.en: Should the label be applied outside or inside the shrink film? (What are the risks of each?)

blocks.zh: 黑色束帶遮蓋了右側標籤的 20% 條碼面積，是否合規？
blocks.en: Black straps cover 20% of the barcode area of the right-side label. Is this compliant?

blocks.zh: 冷藏環境（2–8°C）對標籤黏著劑有何要求？應要求供應商提供何種規格證明？
blocks.en: What requirements does a cold-chain environment (2–8°C) place on the label adhesive? What specification evidence should be requested from the supplier?

blocks.zh: 如果倉庫地板到棧板底部有 15 cm 的棧板板材，標籤底部應距地面幾 mm？
blocks.en: If the pallet boards between the warehouse floor and the underside of the pallet load are 15 cm thick, how many mm above the floor should the bottom of the label be?

blocks.zh: 思考練習 4 — 多系統環境條碼管理
blocks.en: Practice Exercise 4 — Barcode Management in a Multi-System Environment

blocks.zh: 你的工廠現有三套系統共存：GS1-128（CDMO 自用）、Code 39 + Data Identifiers（歐洲客戶 A）、Code 128 + Data Identifiers（美國客戶 B）。掃描器設定上應如何處理？
blocks.en: Your site has three systems in use at the same time: GS1-128 (the CDMO's own), Code 39 + Data Identifiers (European customer A) and Code 128 + Data Identifiers (US customer B). How should the scanners be configured?

blocks.zh: 哪個 ISO 15394 選項對應哪個客戶？
blocks.en: Which ISO 15394 option corresponds to which customer?

blocks.zh: 若要全部支援，掃描器需要什麼能力（符號學識別碼）？
blocks.en: To support all of them, what capability (symbology identifiers) do the scanners need?

blocks.zh: 若主機系統無法辨識 ]C0 vs ]C1，會發生什麼問題？
blocks.en: What problem arises if the host system cannot distinguish ]C0 from ]C1?
